requirement: Map a create-antibiotic-group command to a new AntibioticGroup model: copy the name and description, keep the parent ID as supplied (including null for a root group), let the entity generate its ID, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The mapper is constructed without dependencies

inputs.text: Subgroup command (Penicillins) with a parent ID
Root-group command (Beta-lactams) with a null parent ID

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with a new model
Name and description copied from the command
Parent ID preserved as supplied (null stays null) and a generated non-empty ID

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
